variants.name: 초대장 공방
variants.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original casual match-3 tile design concept sheet for Cloud Garden, Lumi's invitation. Create a polished landscape game art presentation, approximately 1536x1024. Two clearly separated areas: LEFT 38% has six LARGE isolated tile icons in a clean 3-column by 2-row arrangement; RIGHT 58% shows a perfectly aligned dense NINE COLUMN by NINE ROW match-3 board using the same six icons, repeated in varied order. No icons outside this system. Every cell has exactly one icon, regular square pitch, no gaps between cells; icon silhouettes almost fill cells but do not touch neighbors. Use warm medium sand taupe background and very subtle square cell boundaries, no white backdrop. Direction A: INVITATION WORKSHOP. Six original objects in order: coral RED plump wax postal seal with very simple embossed leaf; mid BLUE folded envelope with one triangular flap; warm golden YELLOW short chunky old-fashioned key at a diagonal, round head and two teeth; leaf GREEN chunky feather quill with only two simple broad grooves; iris PURPLE squat ink bottle with wide stopper; tangerine ORANGE rolled scroll with short curved ends. Avoid any fruit, ruby, shield, bell, crown, star gem, ribbon bow. Premium sculpted 3D casual-game sprites, strong bold silhouette readable at 36 pixels, simple chunky volumes and clear distinct colors, satin painted wood and enamel with VERY LOW rough broad highlights, soft diffuse upper-left light, rich colored half tones and darker undersides for depth. No pure white specular patches, no bloom, glow, sparkles, metallic shine, neon, golden outer rims or black outlines. Lively friendly saturated midtones, never washed out pastel, grey, drab or oversaturated. No text, letters, numbers, headings, watermark, logo, full phone UI, buttons, mascot or ornamental frame. This is a new original tile family, not a reproduction of any existing game's tile set.

Soft studio light, no white specular patches or reflection strips, no bloom, no glow, no particles, no glitter, no metallic gold edges. variants.name: 구름섬 소품
variants.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original casual match-3 tile concept sheet for Cloud Garden floating-island theme. Landscape approximately 1536x1024. LEFT 38% six LARGE icons laid out in 3 columns and 2 rows on the same plain warm medium sand taupe background. RIGHT 58% a perfectly straight NINE COLUMN by NINE ROW square match-3 grid using ONLY the same six icons, mixed repeats, one object per touching square cell, consistent scale, no gaps or overlap, subtle thin square cell boundaries. Direction C: SKY ISLAND CHARMS. Six original forms: coral RED chunky paper windmill with four thick folded vanes, mid BLUE puffy asymmetric three-lobed cloud, warm golden YELLOW kite with a rounded diamond paper face and one very short thick curved tail (NOT a gemstone), leaf GREEN curled feather with a single simple center groove, iris PURPLE broad puffy crescent moon, tangerine ORANGE small folded paper boat with broad triangular sail-like paper fold. Premium 3D soft-touch resin figurines, slightly flattened face-on for puzzle readability, bold compact rounded silhouettes, large unified colored surfaces, deep colored lower side shading. Cheerful strong mid-value colors with moderate saturation, broad soft diffuse light, only low-contrast colored satin sheen, no pure white light patches. Visually very different from medieval royal symbols and shiny gems. No fruit, shield, crown, bell, bow, faceted ruby or star jewel. No harsh gloss, bloom, glow, neon, sparkle, gold rim, detailed decoration or black outline. No text, letters, numbers, headings, logo, watermark, mascot, buttons, phone frame or game UI. Icon shape clarity at 36 pixels matters more than tiny detail.
